keywords: EIP-8141 区块执行 gas 先于退款计算
summary: 周六的讨论集中在原生 AA。lightclient 回应 Base 上线 8130 的消息：8130 有一半是不该写进协议的应用层细节，8141 支持无许可创新，不强迫钱包和用户采用特定模式。Hudson Jameson 问 AA 之争最后得到了什么，用 AA 的智能钱包似乎并没有普及。规范上，提交了 EIP-8141 区块执行 gas 在退款前计算的修改，calldata 底价修正合并。dapplion 提交 EIP 移除同步委员会，发行减少约 3%。

items.title: EIP-8141：区块执行 gas 在退款前计算（EIP-7778）
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。EIP-8141 采用 EIP-8037 的二维 gas 模型，并与 EIP-7778 在同一分叉激活；EIP-8037 在退款前计算区块执行维度，退款降低付款方成本但不释放交易占用的区块容量，这是 EIP-7778 要守住的 DoS 边界。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: account block execution gas before refund (EIP-7778)
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. EIP-8141 adopts EIP-8037's two-dimensional gas model and activates in the same fork as EIP-7778; EIP-8037 accounts the block execution dimension before the storage refund, so a refund lowers the payer's cost without freeing the block capacity the transaction occupied, the DoS bound EIP-7778 exists to keep.

items.title_en: dapplion: just wrote an EIP to reduce ETH issuance by 3% by removing the sync committee
items.note_en: 18:54, with PR 12228. It removes the sync committee, its aggregate, subnets, domains and rewards, and the Altair light client protocol built on it; `SYNC_REWARD_WEIGHT` is removed and not redistributed, so consensus issuance falls by 2/64.

keywords_en: looking back at the AA wars
EIP-8141 block execution gas before refunds
summary_en: Saturday's discussion centered on native AA. Responding to Base's plan to ship 8130, lightclient said half of 8130 is application-layer detail that does not belong in the protocol, while 8141 supports permissionless innovation without forcing wallets and users into specific patterns. Hudson Jameson asked what came of the AA wars, since smart wallets using AA do not seem to have taken off. In the spec, EIP-8141 gets a PR accounting block execution gas before refunds (submitted), and the calldata floor fix was merged. dapplion submitted an EIP removing the sync committee, cutting issuance by about 3%.
